response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished generalist software engineer with 15+ years of experience, but that experience is almost entirely in web, mobile, and backend application development (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, Ember). The role requires SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator architecture, deep-learning workload optimization, and hardware-software co-design — none of which appear in the resume. The only adjacent signals are brief C/C++ work at National Instruments (LabWindows/CVI IDE tooling, not silicon), low-latency service optimization at Sociomantic, and an undergraduate wave-field-synthesis audio project. There is no GPU/SIMD/MIMD, RTL, computer architecture, or DNN training/inference experience, and no advanced degree in a hardware-relevant field. This is a fundamental domain mismatch rather than a seniority gap.
strengths: Deep, long-tenured engineering career with staff/senior-level scope
Some systems-level and performance work: C/C++ at NI, low-latency async services handling millions of req/s
Strong engineering discipline (TDD, CI/CD) plus open-source tooling and public speaking/teaching track record
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, computer architecture, or hardware co-design experience
No AI accelerator, GPU, SIMD/MIMD, or deep-learning workload optimization background
Education is a CS bachelor's with no hardware/architecture specialization; principal-level hardware credibility not evidenced

key_factors.factor: Missing SoC/IP modeling and hardware architecture experience
No AI accelerator / DNN workload optimization background
Extensive senior software engineering and performance-tuning experience
